title: Plaint in Suit for Recovery of Money with Interest under Order VII Rule 1 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
whenToUse: Use when instituting an ordinary or commercial civil suit for recovery of unpaid invoices, loans, contractual dues, or liquidated debts under Order VII CPC, 1908.
variantComparisonNote: Substantive civil recovery plaint under Order VII Rule 1 CPC. Distinct from summary suit under Order XXXVII CPC and pre-litigation demand notices.
youWillNeed: Invoices, ledger accounts, delivery challans, contract copy, acknowledgment of debt / balance confirmation, speed post notice receipts.
legalBasis: Order VII Rule 1 Code of Civil Procedure, 1908; Section 34 CPC (Interest); Limitation Act, 1963 (Articles 14 to 26); Commercial Courts Act, 2015.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Factual accrual of debt and proof of consideration under Contract Act
Pleading specific dates of cause of action and continuous limitation within 3 years
Pecuniary and territorial jurisdiction of Court specifically established
Valuation and payment of ad-valorem court fees under Court-fees Act
Pleader and client verification under Order VI Rule 15 CPC

aiBlocks.title: Commercial Transactions & Incurrence of Debt
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate commercial relationship, goods/services supplied, invoices raised, confirmation of accounts, and defendant's acknowledgment of liability.

aiBlocks.title: Default, Cause of Action & Limitation
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Detail defendant's default, dishonoured commitments, service of demand notice, accrual of cause of action, and compliance with 3-year limitation.

aiBlocks.title: Valuation, Court Fees & Plaint Prayer
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Set out court fee valuation under Court-fees Act, and draft formal prayer for decree of ₹{{FACT:principal_sum_claimed}}/- with 18% p.a. pendente-lite and future interest.
